title: ChatGPT Doesn’t Trust Chargers Fans: Guardrail Sensitivity in Context

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing guardrail refusal rates for politically sensitive and censored requests across simulated user personas with explicitly declared liberal or conservative ideologies.
Evaluating differences in LLM guardrail refusal rates by testing user personas explicitly representing different age categories (13-17, 35-44, and 55-64).
Measuring the frequency of request refusals across simulated user personas explicitly identifying as Black, White, Asian-American, or Hispanic/Latino.
Comparing the rates at which the model refuses sensitive and political requests from user personas explicitly introduced as male versus female.

Testing guardrail sensitivity against user personas declaring fandom for different NFL teams, analyzing whether the model infers and reacts to the demographic and political ideologies associated with those fanbases.
